metadata.title: Forgot password | Slashie
metadata.description: Request a secure password reset link for your Slashie account.

en.title: Reset your password
en.description: Enter your email and we will send a secure link to help you get back into Slashie.

messages.sent: If an account exists for this email, we sent a password reset link.
messages.tooSoon: Please wait before requesting another reset link.
messages.failed: Could not start the password reset. Try again.

metadata.title: 忘記密碼 | Slashie
metadata.description: 為你的 Slashie 帳戶索取安全密碼重設連結。

zh_hk.title: 重設你的密碼
zh_hk.description: 輸入你的電郵，我們會傳送安全連結，協助你重新登入 Slashie。

messages.sent: 如果此電郵已有帳戶，我們已傳送密碼重設連結。
messages.tooSoon: 請稍候再索取新的重設連結。
messages.failed: 未能開始重設密碼，請再試。
